subject: Soft Serve Machine displaying E-447 error code on POS terminal
description: The soft serve ice cream machine at the Worli location is displaying error code E-447 on the POS terminal (POS-0102-T1). The machine was operational this morning but started showing the error around 3:45 PM during the afternoon rush. The error persists even after a standard power cycle attempt. Staff are unable to process soft serve orders and customers are being turned away. The machine appears to have power and the display is active, but the error code is preventing any operations.
